commercial-portfolio.title: Commercial Portfolio Archive
commercial-portfolio.description: Browse the complete commercial and editorial photography archive from Aaron Bowser Photography.
intro: This archive gathers the commercial and editorial work of Aaron Bowser Photography. These are commissions for brands: fashion, beauty, product, and editorial series. Not a single campaign and not a loose moodboard, but the line the pictures keep across different jobs.

Some of the photographs are made at the Hagen studio, the everyday room of about 40 square metres. Aaron works there every day. Smaller sets, portraits, and product pictures belong there. Larger productions, teams, and builds that need floor and quiet move to the Solingen studio. It is about 100 square metres, available by appointment only, and it can be rented for a production. When a collection or a product should not come into the studio, the work is photographed on location in North Rhine-Westphalia.

The edit places lookbooks next to beauty details, clear product photographs, and editorial portraits. Light, crop, and tone should stay recognizable across the series, so a brand reads the same way on the website, in the lookbook, and in the campaign. Someone planning a production can see how the work looks before the conversation turns to place, use, and scope.
